answers.why: The LORD identifies himself as the God of the nation Israel.
Israel is God's chosen people for whose sake he calls the ruler by name.
The Holy One of Israel is the nation's maker, speaking concerning his children.
The God of Israel is invoked as the nation's saviour.
Israel's salvation is followed by plural assurances that its people will not be ashamed.
God promises salvation in Zion for Israel as his glory.
The collective phrase 'our redeemer' identifies the Holy One of Israel as the people's God.
Coming forth from Judah's waters describes descent from the ancestor Judah.
The house of Jacob invokes the God of Israel as its national God.
Those claiming the holy city rely upon the God of their nation Israel.
God addresses his called people collectively as Jacob and Israel.
The Holy One of Israel addresses the nation as its redeemer and teacher.
